risks.title: Unplanned Manufacturing Interruptions
risks.score_rationale: The text describes multiple potential causes of manufacturing interruptions: fires, natural disasters, equipment failures, social unrest. Impacts include capacity reduction, inability to serve customers, financial claims and reputational harm. While mitigation measures exist, reference to 'major or prolonged interruptions' indicates significant risk. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Supply Chain and Transportation Dependence
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed with examples of potential disruptions: strikes, supplier bankruptcies. Consequences include delivery delays, inability to sell, increased costs. The critical importance of supply chain and reliance on third parties for raw material and finished product transportation justify high severity. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Geopolitical and Trade Policy Risks
risks.score_rationale: The text details risks from operations in multiple countries: political instability, regulatory changes, trade disputes, tariffs. International supply chain risks include disruptions and cost fluctuations. The potential impact of tariffs and trade policies is particularly emphasized. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Data Protection Risks
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned repeatedly, with detailed description of threats: cyberattacks, ransomware, generative AI. Potential consequences include operational disruption, data loss, reputational harm, litigation. The intensity of language and mention of generative AI as an aggravating factor underscore high severity. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Product Development and Innovation Risks
risks.score_rationale: Company success depends on new product development, but the text highlights potential difficulties: development failures, production scale-up issues, delays. These difficulties can impact customer service capability, reputation and financial position. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Intellectual Property and Competition Risks
risks.score_rationale: IP protection is critical, but the text mentions risk that competitors copy products or processes, with potentially difficult legal remedies. Reliance on proprietary nature of technology and variable foreign protection justify moderate severity. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Customer and Distributor Financial Distress
risks.score_rationale: The text mentions reliance on third-party distributors and risk of their or customers' financial distress or bankruptcy. This could result in lower revenues, uncollectible receivables and inventory management issues, affecting liquidity and results. (default score, subject to refinement)
